title: Cordycepin Regulates the Nrf2/Hmox1 Signaling Pathway to Inhibit Ferroptosis and Improve AKI-CKD.
authors: Xi, Luming; Bai, Mengqi; Li, Junhu; Zhao, Zhibo; Zhou, Xiaoshuang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究虫草素通过Nrf2/Hmox1通路抑制铁死亡改善AKI-CKD，虽含分子对接但核心是疾病表型与信号通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Cordycepin (COR) exerts pharmacological effects in various diseases, yet its role in tissue repair following acute kidney injury (AKI) remains to be fully elucidated. This study aimed to investigate whether COR delays the progression from acute kidney injury to chronic kidney disease (AKI-CKD) and to explore its underlying mechanisms. Network pharmacology was employed to identify shared targets among ferroptosis, AKI-CKD, and COR using multiple databases. Gene Ontology (GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) enrichment analyses were performed, followed by molecular docking validation. In vivo, a renal unilateral ischemia-reperfusion (uIRI) mouse model was established in C57Bl/6N mice (n = 20), randomly divided into four groups (n = 5 each): Control, CKD model, COR, and CKD + COR. COR (10 mg/kg) or saline was administered intraperitoneally daily for 2 weeks. Renal pathology and fibrosis were assessed via H&E, PAS, and Masson staining; renal function by serum creatinine and proteinuria. In vitro, HK-2 cells were treated with H(2)O(2) with or without COR, and cell viability was measured by CCK-8. The Nrf2 inhibitor ML385 was used to verify pathway involvement. The mRNA and protein levels of GPX4, ACSL4, Nrf2, and Hmox1 were determined by qRT-PCR and Western blot. Cross-analysis of network pharmocology identified 42 common targets among 459 COR-related, 843 AKI-CKD-related, and 1866 ferroptosis-related genes. PPI network analysis suggested that TNF, IL6, and Hmox1 are key targets. Enrichment analyses indicated involvement in iron homeostasis and oxidative stress responses. Molecular docking revealed strong binding of COR to Nrf2 and Hmox1 (-8.5 and -6.7 kcal/mol). In vivo, model mice showed elevated serum creatinine and proteinuria, severe tubular damage, and increased fibrosis, all significantly ameliorated by COR. In vitro, H(2)O(2) reduced HK-2 cell viability, downregulated GPX4, Nrf2, and Hmox1, and upregulated ACSL4; COR reversed these effects and improved cell survival. ML385 partially blocked COR's protective and regulatory effects, confirming Nrf2/Hmox1 pathway dependence. Our finding indicated that COR inhibits ferroptosis via activation of the Nrf2/Hmox1 signaling pathway, thereby attenuating renal injury and fibrosis and slowing AKI-CKD progression.
abstract_zh: 虫草素（COR）在多种疾病中发挥药理作用，但其在急性肾损伤（AKI）后组织修复中的作用仍有待充分阐明。本研究旨在探讨COR是否延缓急性肾损伤向慢性肾脏病（AKI-CKD）的进展，并探索其潜在机制。采用网络药理学方法，利用多个数据库识别铁死亡、AKI-CKD与COR之间的共同靶点。进行基因本体论（GO）和京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）富集分析，随后进行分子对接验证。在体内实验中，建立C57Bl/6N小鼠（n = 20）肾单侧缺血再灌注（uIRI）模型，随机分为四组（每组n = 5）：对照组、CKD模型组、COR组和CKD + COR组。每日腹腔注射COR（10 mg/kg）或生理盐水，持续2周。通过H&E、PAS和Masson染色评估肾脏病理和纤维化；通过血清肌酐和蛋白尿评估肾功能。在体外实验中，用H(2)O(2)处理HK-2细胞，加或不加COR，并通过CCK-8测量细胞活力。使用Nrf2抑制剂ML385验证通路参与情况。通过qRT-PCR和Western blot测定GPX4、ACSL4、Nrf2和Hmox1的mRNA和蛋白水平。网络药理学交叉分析在459个COR相关、843个AKI-CKD相关和1866个铁死亡相关基因中鉴定出42个共同靶点。PPI网络分析提示TNF、IL6和Hmox1是关键靶点。富集分析表明涉及铁稳态和氧化应激反应。分子对接显示COR与Nrf2和Hmox1结合紧密（-8.5和-6.7 kcal/mol）。在体内实验中，模型小鼠表现出血清肌酐和蛋白尿升高、严重肾小管损伤和纤维化增加，所有这些均被COR显著改善。在体外实验中，H(2)O(2)降低HK-2细胞活力，下调GPX4、Nrf2和Hmox1，并上调ACSL4；COR逆转了这些效应并改善了细胞存活。ML385部分阻断了COR的保护和调节作用，证实了Nrf2/Hmox1通路依赖性。我们的发现表明，COR通过激活Nrf2/Hmox1信号通路抑制铁死亡，从而减轻肾损伤和纤维化，并延缓AKI-CKD进展。
